NAME
    set - Set a flake input to a specific revision

SYNOPSIS

    confctl [global options] inputs set [command options] <input-name> <rev>

COMMAND OPTIONS
    --[no-]changelog     - Include git log in the commit message (default:
                           enabled)
    --[no-]commit        - Commit changes to git
    -d, --[no-]downgrade - Treat change as downgrade for changelog direction
    --[no-]editor        - Open $EDITOR with commit message (default: enabled)
